queries_run: Engineering & Construction shortage OR oversupply structural OR cyclical 2026 2027
Engineering & Construction supply discipline new capacity timeline
STRL Sterling Infrastructure product demand durability structural 2026

findings.claim: ABC 2026 estimate: 349,000 net new construction workers needed in 2026 (lower than recent years); ENR frames it as cyclical demand cooling layered on structural workforce limits (retirements, demographics); ABC 2027 projection ~456,000 workers.
findings.source: ENR 'Construction's Labor Relief Masks Structural Risk as Demand Cools'; ABC via Hardware Retailing

findings.claim: Linesight Americas report (June 2026): new or expanded supplier capacity may ease supply pressure in 2H 2026 into 2027, though vendor prioritization and production slots remain critical.
findings.source: Linesight Construction Market Insights Americas, 24 June 2026

findings.claim: STRL raised 2026 guidance to revenue $4.0-4.15B, adj EPS $19.70-20.30; signed backlog $4.33B; growth driven by data center and semiconductor projects; Cantor view that the constraint is capacity not demand; residential remains soft.
findings.source: Quartr STRL Q2 2026 earnings summary; Nasdaq/Zacks articles

findings.claim: AIA 2026 consensus forecast: nonresidential building spending up ~3% in 2027; data center strong while many traditional sectors flag. Commentary notes caution on 2027 from late-2026 deceleration with multi-year rebound optimism from 2028.
findings.source: AIA Consensus Construction Forecast; ECM 'Navigating Construction Growth in 2027'

supply_demand_durability.note: All findings from search summaries; dates approximate for AIA, ENR and Quartr; no verbatim excerpts obtained.
